references.text: The first time God sent quail to the Israelites in the wilderness, when they complained about lack of food after leaving Egypt.
The preceding verse describing how the Lord sent a wind that brought quail to the camp.
The psalmist describes how God sent the east wind and the south wind, causing meat to rain down on the people like dust, birds as numerous as the sand of the sea.
The psalm reminds us how the people prayed, and God sent quail and satisfied them with bread from heaven.
Describes how the people were overcome by craving in the wilderness and tested God, and He gave them what they asked for.
